[[MF Pro]] | first_date = 7 March 2026 | first_date_aired = | last_date = December 2026 | last_date_aired = 14 November 2026 | total_events = 12 | total_fights = 116 | title_fights = 26 | preceded_by = [[2025 in Misfits Boxing|2025]] | followed_by = [[2027 in Misfits Boxing and MF Pro|2027]] |website={{URL|https://misfitsboxing.com/}}}} '''2026 in Misfits Boxing and MF Pro''' is the fifth year in the history of [[Misfits Boxing]] and first year in the history for [[MF Pro]], two [[boxing]] promotions founded by English [[YouTuber]] [[KSI]] and run by [[Mams Taylor]], [[Kalle Sauerland]], and Nisse Sauerland.{{Cite web |last=Blackburn |first=Tom |date=May 6, 2022 |title=KSI set to make return to the boxing ring this summer |url=https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/sport/boxing/ksi-boxing-comeback-next-fight-23887645 |website=Manchester Evening News}} 2026 sees the debut of MF Sports [[professional boxing]] division 'MF Pro.'
